representation: Original WCC and GitHub HTTP metadata bodies, an indexed-query control, a current publisher XLS object and immutable protocol observations. The gzip inventory is a deterministic logical metadata projection of all observed public dataset/resource host identities. National HTTP pages and resource prefixes are retained in local acquisition envelopes, with parent hashes in the portable records.
